verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a password manager, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a self-hostable server or deployment option. Community reports say only the client apps are open source, the server code is not published, and there is no self-hosting option. The GitHub BUILD.md covers building the Android client locally, not hosting the core service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
